subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: Both arms shall contribute themselves as self-registered descriptors — each a single-file contribution carrying its verb, one-line help, applicability flag, and run behavior — adding no line to any shared umbrella enumeration, dispatch, or help output.
rationale: the composition model forbids shared-line edits (F-4, AP-23); parity with every other class means zero-touch registration
fit_criterion: adding the two arms produces no hand edit to the umbrella's shared enumeration/dispatch/help; `docgate` usage lists both arms from their descriptors
